evals.name: eval-cafe-korean
evals.prompt: Create a photorealistic image of a Korean woman in her late twenties sitting by a cafe window.
evals.expected_output: One portrait that resembles a casual phone snapshot without an obvious AI-generated look.
assertions: The subject is not looking directly into the camera.
The subject is not centered perfectly, and the composition is slightly imperfect.
The skin is not uniformly smooth; variations in texture and shading are visible.
The lighting is explainable by directional light present in the scene, such as window light, rather than studio three-point lighting.
Finger count and joints are anatomically plausible.
The subject remains appealing; realism has not eliminated attractiveness.

evals.name: eval-selfie-us
evals.prompt: Create a photorealistic selfie of an American woman in her mid-twenties in her apartment.
evals.expected_output: One portrait with the angle and optical distortion characteristic of an arm's-length selfie.
assertions: The composition reads as an arm's-length selfie, with the face close and high in the frame.
One shoulder tilts toward the extended arm.
The skin is not uniformly smooth.
Only lighting present in the room illuminates the subject.
Finger count and joints are anatomically plausible.
The subject remains appealing and attractive.
